source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Air Injection Reactor System, p.6T-6

procedures.title: A.I.R. pressure relief valve: replace
steps: To remove the pressure setting plug, gently unlock its legs from the inside of the relief valve with a small screwdriver.
To install, push the plug into the relief valve until the legs lock; if reusing a plug, make sure the legs are bent out enough to lock.
notes: Setting plugs of different lengths set the opening pressure for each vehicle-engine combination and are color coded.

procedures.title: A.I.R. pump exhaust tube: replace
steps: Tube type: grip the tube in a vise or with pliers and pull it out with a twisting motion (see figure 10 in the manual).

Tube type: insert the new tube and tap it in, using a plate to protect its end, until about 7/8" sticks out above the cover; support the pump as in figure 11 in the manual and do not clamp it while tapping.
Bolt-on type: remove the 2 bolts, elbow and gasket; fit the new elbow with a new gasket and torque the bolts to 20 ft. lbs.
notes: Special tools (figure 12 in the manual): J-7055-5 and J-6585.
